decision: Retain current ex3.pt and ex3_result.hwresult; preserve fine-tuned candidate separately. Two net extra successes out of 180 with two new regressions are not enough to claim a robust overall advantage.
limits: One training seed and one fresh paired evaluation set. No confidence or universal reliability claim. Six correction-source cases are training scenes, not independent tests.
